title: 第9章  魔鬼炼丹师，火凤儿
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
“等等……”
看着撸起袖子就要开干的火凤儿，叶长天连忙叫了起来。
“小弟弟，你既然来了姐姐的离火宫，那就没有反悔的余地。”
火凤儿拿起抽血工具，笑吟吟地道：“你尽情地叫吧，就算叫破喉咙也没用的。”
“火姐姐，你榨干了三十多位杂役弟子都没炼制出古方上的丹药，有没有可能是你补全的丹方有问题？”
叶长天连忙说道。
他可不想被火凤儿抽得扶墙而出，然后十天半个月都缓不过来。
“你这不是废话吗？”
火凤儿翻了个白眼：“要是姐姐补全的丹方没问题，这丹药早就被我炼出来了，还用得着抽你们的血来不断试验？”
“……”
这特么不是把杂役弟子当小白鼠吗？
火凤儿魔鬼炼丹师的名头，果然是名不虚传！
看着已经拿着容器准备抽血的火凤儿，叶长天连忙道：“火姐姐，这上古残方我能帮你补全。”
“嗯？”
火凤儿愣了一愣。
下一秒。
她就将那张妩媚至极的脸庞直接凑到了叶长天面前。
“小弟弟，欺骗姐姐可不会有什么好下场的哦。”
火凤儿伸出两根纤纤玉指，挑起了叶长天的下巴。
她的这个动作，令得某处波涛汹涌的地方，甚至都快压在叶长天的脸上了。

“火姐姐，我能帮你补全这张上古残方，就是需要一些灵石。”
叶长天连忙移开目光。
这女人可是性情古怪的魔鬼炼丹师。
虽然她是自己主动凑上来的，还是不要乱看为妙。
“小弟弟，只要你能补全丹方，价格随便开。”
火凤儿咯咯娇笑一声，直接将那上古残方递到叶长天的面前。
她可是玄黄大世界北域少有的四品炼丹师，地位同等元婴大佬的存在，而且比一般元婴大佬还要富有！
对火凤儿来说，最不差的就是灵石！
能用灵石解决的问题，那都不是问题！
叶长天接过上古残方，然后意念一动，上古残方就在掌心鬼魅消失，直接出现在阴阳造化界。
阴阳造化界中，他还存留了五千灵石凝聚的阴阳之力。
也不知道这些阴阳之力够不够。
要是不够修复这张上古残方，他也只能找火凤儿预支一些灵石了。
上古残方出现在阴阳造化界，就随着阴阳之力的注入开始发生变化。
不一会儿。
一张完完整整、字迹清晰的丹方就呈现在了叶长天的面前。
“竟然是化神丹！”
感受着上古丹方的完整信息，叶长天不由倒吸一口凉气。
化神丹！
这可是上古时期的五品丹药。

顾名思义，这化神丹就是能够让元婴化神，突破化神境的丹药。
如今玄黄大世界北域，元婴巅峰就是天花板。
之所以没有元婴之上的化神境强者，主要就是因为一场大劫导致许多高阶传承断绝。
化神丹就是失传的高阶丹药之一！
叶长天毫不怀疑，这化神丹的丹方一旦传了出去，恐怕足以令北域无数元婴大佬都为之疯狂啊。
“不能将修复的上古丹方直接还给火凤儿！”
瞬间修复上古残废的能力太过惊骇世俗，他也并不想让人知道自己有这种能力。
叶长天目光微微闪烁。
他迅速捡起一块黑色石头，在地板上写写画画起来。
火凤儿本来还有些疑惑，可当她看到叶长天在地板上写的内容时，瞬间就被吸引住了。
化神丹丹方！
叶长天竟然真的将残缺的化神丹丹方补全了！
最让火凤儿惊骇的是。
叶长天补全的内容，让她许多地方一下就通了，瞬间有了一种赫然开朗的感觉。
“原来如此……”
火凤儿美眸中浮现出了一抹难以掩饰的欣喜。
她推演了一下叶长天补全的丹方，发现丹方几乎已经没有任何瑕疵。
按照这个丹方，绝对能将化神丹炼制出来！
“小弟弟，姐姐真是爱死你了，你有什么条件尽管提出来，姐姐都可以满足你！”
火凤儿激动地把叶长天的脑袋抱在胸前。

叶长天顿时只感觉两座大山朝他压来，让他有一种快要喘不过气来的感觉。
“火姐姐，你给我五千灵石再加一枚筑基丹就行了。”
叶长天连忙挣脱了火凤儿的怀抱。
他也没有狮子大开口。
五千灵石是修复化神丹丹方的本钱，一枚筑基丹则是他需要的报酬。
火凤儿可是太玄宗数一数二的丹道大师。
他以后必定还有用得着的地方。
就当结个善缘了。
火凤儿大手一挥，一枚丹药以及一堆灵石直接出现在叶长天的面前。
“小弟弟，这是一枚上品筑基丹以及一万灵石，算是姐姐给你的报酬。”
“接下来姐姐要闭关炼丹，你现在可以离开了，等下次有需要的时候，姐姐再找你哦。”
火凤儿说完，一双美眸就死死地锁定在叶长天补全的丹方上。
以人血为引，完全是她陷入了补全丹方的误区。
既然炼制化神丹无需血引，她自然就不需要抽叶长天了。
见得火凤儿已经彻底被化神丹丹方吸引，叶长天也是迅速收了灵石与筑基丹，默默退出了炼丹房。
回到杂役峰。
叶长天发现月青霜并不在房间内，似乎有事出去了。
不过——
月青霜可是太玄宗曾经的天月圣女，即便身体出了意外，他也并不担心月青霜的安全。
“如今筑基丹到手，当务之急就是将筑基丹提升到完美品质，突破筑基境！”

叶长天双眼中精光一闪，从怀中掏出火凤儿给他的上品筑基丹。
筑基丹的价格可不便宜。
哪怕一枚下品筑基丹，也能卖到一千灵石一枚。
品质越高自然越珍贵。
上品筑基丹极为难得，甚至可以卖到五千灵石一枚，而且还是有价无市！
叶长天意念一动，将筑基丹放入了阴阳造化界……
而就在叶长天准备破境的同时。
宋浩也是第一时间收到了叶长天毫发无损从离火宫回来的消息。
“该死的，这叶长天究竟走了什么狗屎运，去了离火宫都能毫发无损地回来。”
宋浩面色显得有些不太好看。
本以为叶长天去了离火宫，他就能借离火宫那位将叶长天搞残。
没想到计划竟然失败了。
“浩哥不必动怒，咱们一计不成，那就再施一计就好，我不相信他次次都有这么好的运气。”
在宋浩面前，一位尖嘴猴腮的青年男子，脸庞上露出了一抹残忍的笑容。
“这一次，我定会让叶长天死无葬身之地！”
content_en:
"Wait..."
Seeing Huo Feng'er rolling up his sleeves and about to start fucking, Ye Changtian shouted quickly.
"Little brother, since you have come to my sister's Lihuo Palace, there is no room for regret."
Huo Feng'er picked up the blood drawing tool and said with a smile: "You can scream as much as you want, even if your throat is broken, it will be useless."
"Sister Huo, you have drained more than 30 servant disciples and still haven't refined the ancient elixir. Is it possible that there is something wrong with the elixir you completed?"
Ye Changtian said quickly.
He didn't want to be whipped out by Huo Feng'er and then be unable to recover for ten days and a half.
"Aren't you talking nonsense?"
Huo Feng'er rolled her eyes: "If the elixir recipe completed by my sister was OK, I would have refined this elixir long ago. Do I still need to draw your blood for continuous testing?"
"..."
Aren't you treating the handyman disciples as guinea pigs?
Huo Feng'er's reputation as the devil's alchemist is indeed well-deserved!
Looking at Huo Feng'er who was already holding a container and preparing to draw blood, Ye Changtian said quickly: "Sister Huo, I can help you complete this ancient remnant recipe."
"Huh?"
Huo Feng'er was stunned for a moment.
The next second.
She put her extremely charming face directly in front of Ye Changtian.
"Little brother, you won't end well if you lie to your sister."
Huo Feng'er stretched out two slender jade fingers and lifted Ye Changtian's chin.
This movement of hers caused some rough waves to almost hit Ye Changtian's face.
"Sister Huo, I can help you complete this ancient remnant recipe, but you need some spiritual stones."
Ye Changtian quickly looked away.
This woman is a devil alchemist with an eccentric temperament.
Although she came here on her own initiative, it was better not to look around.
"Little brother, as long as you can complete the prescription, you can set the price as you please."
Huo Feng'er chuckled and handed the ancient remnant recipe directly to Ye Changtian.
She is a rare fourth-grade alchemist in the northern region of the Xuanhuang World. She has the same status as the Yuanying bosses, and is richer than the average Yuanying bosses!
For Huo Feng'er, the best thing is the spirit stone!
Problems that can be solved with spiritual stones are not problems!
Ye Changtian took the ancient remnant prescription, and then with a thought, the ancient remnant prescription disappeared in the palm of his hand and appeared directly in the Yin and Yang world of creation.
In the yin and yang world of creation, he still retains the power of yin and yang condensed by five thousand spirit stones.
I don’t know if these yin and yang powers are enough.
If there wasn't enough to repair this ancient remnant recipe, he could only ask Huo Feng'er to advance some spiritual stones.
The ancient remnants appeared in the yin and yang world of creation, and began to change with the injection of yin and yang power.
Soon.
A complete prescription with clear handwriting appeared in front of Ye Changtian.
"It's actually the God Transformation Pill!"
Feeling the complete information about the ancient elixir, Ye Changtian couldn't help but take a breath.
Transformation Pill!
This is a fifth-grade elixir from ancient times.
As the name suggests, this god-transforming pill is a pill that can transform the Yuanying into a god and break through the realm of god-transformation.
Now in the Northern Territory of the Xuanhuang World, the peak of Nascent Soul is the ceiling.
The main reason why there are no powerful people in the spirit transformation realm above Nascent Soul is because a great catastrophe caused many high-level inheritances to be cut off.
The Transformation Pill is one of the lost high-level pills!
Ye Changtian has no doubt that once the recipe for this divine transformation pill is spread, it will probably be enough to make countless Nascent Soul bosses in the Northern Territory go crazy for it.
"You cannot return the restored ancient elixir directly to Huo Feng'er!"
The ability to instantly repair ancient cripples is too shocking to the world, and he doesn't want people to know that he has this ability.
Ye Changtian's eyes flickered slightly.
He quickly picked up a black stone and started writing on the floor.
Huo Feng'er was a little confused at first, but when she saw what Ye Changtian wrote on the floor, she was instantly attracted.
God-transforming elixir recipe!
Ye Changtian actually made up for the incomplete God Transformation Pill.All done!
What shocked Huo Feng'er the most was.
Ye Changtian's supplementary content made her understand many things at once, and she instantly felt bright and cheerful.
"That's it..."
An unconcealable joy appeared in Huo Feng'er's beautiful eyes.
She deduced the prescription prepared by Ye Changtian and found that there were almost no flaws in the prescription.
According to this pill recipe, the God Transformation Pill can definitely be refined!
"Little brother, my sister loves you so much. If you ask for any conditions, she will satisfy you!"
Huo Feng'er excitedly hugged Ye Changtian's head to her chest.
Ye Changtian suddenly felt two big mountains pressing down on him, making him feel like he was about to be out of breath.
"Sister Huo, just give me five thousand spirit stones and one foundation-building pill."
Ye Changtian quickly broke away from Huo Feng'er's arms.
He also doesn’t have the big mouth of a lion.
Five thousand spirit stones are the capital for repairing the God Transformation Pill, and one Foundation Establishment Pill is the reward he needs.
Huo Feng'er was one of the top alchemy masters in Taixuan Sect.
He will definitely be useful in the future.
Just make a good relationship.
Huo Feng'er waved his hand, and a pill and a bunch of spiritual stones appeared directly in front of Ye Changtian.
"Little brother, this is a high-grade foundation-building pill and ten thousand spirit stones. It is considered as the reward given to you by my sister."
"Next, my sister will go into seclusion to refine elixirs. You can leave now. I will come back to you when I need you next time."
After Huo Feng'er finished speaking, her beautiful eyes were fixed on the elixir that Ye Changtian had completed.
Using human blood as a guide completely caused her to fall into the misunderstanding of supplementing the elixir recipe.
Since refining the magic pill does not require blood, she naturally does not need to draw Ye Changtian.
Seeing that Huo Feng'er had been completely attracted to the God Transformation Pill recipe, Ye Changtian also quickly collected the spirit stones and Foundation Establishment Pills and silently exited the alchemy room.
Return to Miscellaneous Peak.
Ye Changtian found that Yue Qingshuang was not in the room, and seemed to have gone out for something.
But——
Yue Qingshuang was the former Heavenly Moon Saint of Taixuan Sect. Even if her body had an accident, he was not worried about Yue Qingshuang's safety.
"Now that the Foundation Establishment Pill is in hand, the top priority is to improve the Foundation Establishment Pill to perfect quality and break through to the Foundation Establishment Realm!"
Ye Changtian's eyes flashed, and he took out the top-grade foundation-building pill given to him by Huo Feng'er from his arms.
The price of the Foundation Establishment Pill is not cheap.
Even a low-grade foundation-building pill can be sold for a thousand spirit stones.
The higher the quality, the more valuable it is.
Top-grade foundation-building pills are extremely rare and can even be sold for five thousand spirit stones each, and they are still priceless!
With a thought, Ye Changtian put the Foundation Establishment Pill into the Yin and Yang world of creation...
And just when Ye Changtian was preparing to break through.
Song Hao also immediately received the news that Ye Changtian had returned from Lihuo Palace unscathed.
"Damn it, what kind of bad luck did Ye Changtian have? He went to Lihuo Palace and came back unscathed."
Song Hao's face looked a little unhappy.
He thought that if Ye Changtian went to Lihuo Palace, he could use the person from Lihuo Palace to cripple Ye Changtian.
Unexpectedly, the plan failed.
"Brother Hao, don't be angry. If we can't succeed with one plan, then we can just try another one. I don't believe he has such good luck every time."
In front of Song Hao, a young man with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks showed a cruel smile on his face.
"This time, I will definitely let Ye Changtian die without a burial place!"
